item.title: March 4, 2026: Days Gone By
item.description: 100 years ago — 1926 When his eight-year-old daughter, Ruth, was placed on the stand to testify against him, Adolph Strockbine of Ashland, on trial for the slaying of his young wife, collapsed at 12:10 o’clock Thursday and the trial had to be halted. The collapsing of the accused father was one of the most dramatic and touching scenes enacted in the history of the Schuylkill county courts.
